name: Phase 1: Foundations
desc: Build your base — understand how the internet works, get comfortable with Linux and terminal, learn Git.

name: Phase 2: Pick a Language
desc: Choose one backend language and learn it deeply. Python, JavaScript (Node.js), Java, or Go are great choices.

name: Phase 3: Core Backend
desc: Learn HTTP, build REST APIs, connect to databases, implement authentication. This is where you become a backend developer.

name: Phase 4: Security & APIs
desc: Secure your applications, explore GraphQL, learn API design best practices.

name: Phase 5: Architecture
desc: Structure your code properly. Learn caching, queues, real-time communication, and server patterns.

name: Phase 6: DevOps & Infra
desc: Containerize, automate testing, set up CI/CD, monitor your apps in production.

name: Phase 7: Scale & System Design
desc: Think at scale. Learn system design, concurrency, microservices, and database scaling.

name: Phase 8: Specialization
desc: Go deep into areas that interest you or your career demands.
